_doc: CAL v0 k1 line hints (probe P6). Approximate endpoints (full-res px) of straight world lines picked by eye on the median background of TRAIN frames of each framing (/esk/p6/<framing>_bg.jpg on the Modal volume). intercycle.framing.trace_edge snaps each hint to the sub-pixel edge. Lines nearly radial to the image centre carry no k1 information and were dropped (c14: blue plate edge, die-plate edge); the c14 right column's trace followed a ladder and was dropped.
